title: First bad required sign
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $\{\pm1\}^n$, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula is nonconstant. The first bad required sign is the sign required at the first bad coordinate by the first compatible term.
caveat: The definitions of the first compatible term and first bad coordinate, and the precise meaning of compatibility, are not supplied.
